d:
Dilli se lekar jharkhand tak kangres aur bijepi ke bich siyasi bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. 1 navanbar ko dilli ke ramlila maidan men kangres ‘vot bachao, desh bachao’ abhiyan ke tahat raili karegi. kangres ne SIR aur mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ko apne nishane par rakha hai.
Vahin, bijepi kangres ke abhiyan ke javab men ‘loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao’ abhiyan chala rahi hai. jharkhand ki rajdhani ranchi men bijepi 2 navanbar ko padyatra nikalegi.
